title: Multi-Agent AI System for Pharmaceutical Commercial Forecasting: GPT-5 Orchestration with Specialized Agent Architecture

contributions.purpose: 构建多智能体药品商业预测系统逼近咨询顾问精度
contributions.mechanism: GPT-5 编排 8 步流水线协调 4 个专用 agent(DataCollection/DeepSeek、MarketAnalysis/GPT-5、Forecast/多方法集成、Review/Perplexity),按 LLM 能力做任务路由
contributions.evaluation: 整体 41.3% MAPE,优于 peak heuristic 71.2%/ensemble 80.8%/enhanced analog 100.2%,逼近顾问基线 40%
contributions.domain: 制药商业预测 / 多智能体 LLM 系统
contributions.source_quote: Multi-agent system implementing MASSIVE_OVERHAUL_PLAN methodology with GPT-5 orchestration across 4 specialized agents

contributions.purpose: 用治疗领域先验与增强类比校准做药物差异化预测
contributions.mechanism: TA-specific 峰值份额先验(肿瘤 0.35/心血管 0.25/罕见病 0.50)+ DTW 轨迹相似度 + Y2/peak 归一化 + 权重上限重分配
contributions.evaluation: Keytruda 34.6% peak APE、Repatha 33.6% peak APE;但 enhanced analog 本身 100.2% MAPE(Repatha 达 238%/138.3% APE)为全场最差
contributions.source_quote: Systematic calibration approach using therapeutic area-specific parameters and drug-specific adjustments

contributions.purpose: 构建真实制药数据集与时间切分回测框架
contributions.mechanism: openFDA Drugs@FDA(61 药 89% 覆盖)+ SEC EDGAR XBRL 结构化抽取(116 条营收/28 产品),train≤2019/test≥2020 温度切分 + bootstrap 95% CI
contributions.evaluation: 61 药覆盖 7 治疗领域;golden set 76.9% pass(10/13);实际仅 2 个完整时间切分测试用例
contributions.source_quote: Our system successfully constructs a comprehensive real dataset with 61 drug launches spanning 7 therapeutic areas ... with complete 5-year revenue trajectories.

contributions.purpose: 证明系统实现按药差异化(修复此前全药同值缺陷)
contributions.mechanism: 对比校准前后各药预测输出
contributions.evaluation: 从此前所有药恒为 $1.66B 变为按药差异化输出(定性,无统计检验)
contributions.source_quote: Successful resolution of identical forecast issue (previously $1.66B for all drugs)

self_declared_provenance.quote: Revenue data extraction utilizes the SEC's structured XBRL API instead of text parsing, providing clean financial data by fiscal year.
The system eliminates all hardcoded values through comprehensive TA-specific parameter sets

notes: 机器生成论文,红旗密集。(1)负结果/trade-off:标称'enhanced' analog forecasting 反而 100.2% MAPE 为全场最差,Repatha 达 238%(138.3% APE);AI Limitations 自曝'multi-agent architecture showed unexpected coordination failures compared to monolithic approaches',与 H2(多 agent 优于单体)假设直接矛盾。(2)幻影章节/结果:2.6-2.8 定义了 H1/H2/H3 三个假设与方法,但正文无任一结果;paper checklist 却称'p<0.01 for H1, p<0.001 for H2/H3'——p 值凭空捏造。Fig1(NPV Monte Carlo n=10000)、Fig2(NPV 敏感性)从未在正文引用/解释,NPV 分析全文无方法描述,为孤立幻影图。(3)幻影/伪造引用:全文多处以 [MASSIVE_OVERHAUL_PLAN] 作学术引用(含 40% 顾问基线来源),实为内部计划文档占位;参考文献 [2] 'OpenAI (2024) GPT-5 Technical Report'——2024 年无 GPT-5,伪造引用;[3] DeepSeek-V3 标 2024 亦误。(4)数据红旗-数字自相矛盾:Keytruda actual peak 同文出现 $25B / SEC $47B(2.3)/ '$42B instead of $25B'(限制)三值打架;Repatha actual $1.5B 却在 SEC 段写 'Repatha (33B)'(荒谬,真实约 1.5B);Keytruda 与 Repatha 的 enhanced analog peak 均为 $3.6B(跨药雷同);Keytruda 41.1%/Repatha 41.5% MAPE 均值恰 41.3%,而整体'validation'仅 2 例。(5)checklist 自曝造数/破坏一致性:Ethics/Reproducibility 称'only synthetic data, no patient information''synthetic data included in conference submission package',与正文反复宣称'real-world pharmaceutical data''actual drug launches''real dataset'直接冲突——真实 vs 合成数据两头下注。Writing 100% AI、seed=42 却 GPT-5 temperature=1.0'required'(与可复现矛盾)。(6)Reproducibility Statement 称'future releases will include a real dataset and backtesting artifacts'且'Phase 0 ... does not include performance claims on real launches',暗示所谓'Phase 5 real validation'数据实际尚未就位。无明确编号贡献列表外的 6 条 intro bullet,已归并为 4 条。
